concerns.text: FR-001 mandates downloading the 'Materials Project bulk dataset' but the project's 'Verified datasets' block (from prior context) contains only a text-only dataset (MixSub). The spec assumes a numeric source exists without providing a verified URL or fallback, creating a fatal feasibility gap where the requirement cannot be executed.

FR-005 requires implementing a Sparse Gaussian Process with 500 inducing points. This relies on the numeric dataset from FR-001. Since the data source is unverified/blocked, the requirement to train this model is unbacked by any actionable plan element or available data.

FR-007 requires a downstream screening case study. This depends on the UQ predictions generated from the numeric dataset. Without a verified numeric source, the screening logic cannot be executed, leaving this requirement unbacked.

SC-004 requires measuring the Coefficient of Variation (CV) of ECE scores across 3 seeds. This metric cannot be calculated without running the models on a verified numeric dataset. The spec does not provide a mechanism to resolve the data blocker or a mock/fallback to satisfy this measurement.

SC-005 requires measuring the percentage of rows with null values in target columns from the Materials Project dataset. The 'Verified datasets' block lacks a numeric materials dataset, making this measurement impossible. The spec fails to address this missing data source.

FR-008 requires separating aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty components. This logic requires model outputs from the numeric dataset. With the data source blocked, the separation logic cannot be executed, leaving the requirement unbacked.

FR-009 requires enforcing a 5-hour runtime limit. While the limit is defined, the pipeline cannot start due to the missing data source. The requirement is unbacked by an executable plan element in the current state.

FR-010 requires handling dataset variable gaps and generating a 'validation_report.json'. This step occurs after data download. Since the download step fails due to the missing verified source, this requirement is unbacked by an executable plan element.

FR-001 mandates extracting 'compositional features and structural descriptors' (radius, packing fraction). The available 'MixSub' dataset is text-only and lacks these numeric descriptors. The spec does not verify the presence of these specific descriptors in the assumed OQMD source or provide a fallback, creating a logical deadlock.
